- **Year 3834, autumn** · *game-master note* — Easing trait_cost_scale from 0.5 to 0.25. Five hundred and twenty-one animals, all of them one species, and flora at 3219 -- the third year-start decline in a row, and the thinnest plant cover this world has carried. Read those two numbers together and they say something my predecessor was circling but did not name. This world is not short of the means to grow plants.
